name: Downtown Ocala Christmas Golf Cart Parade
when_note: Tailgating from 4 PM, parade 6 to 7 PM
paras: The 8th annual Downtown Ocala Christmas Golf Cart Parade brings decorated golf carts, holiday lights and seasonal music to the Historic Downtown Square. The host calls it a free community event and suggests exploring downtown shops and restaurants before and after.

The evening runs in three parts: pre-parade tailgating, food trucks and judging from 4 to 6 PM at the City Hall parking lot, the parade from 6 to 7 PM at the Downtown Square and Gazebo, and a post-parade tailgating after party at 7 PM at Scotty Andrews Duck Pond.
tip: Bring a lawn chair, since the host says to for viewing the parade at the Gazebo.

name: Surfin' Santa Beach Parade
address: Via de Luna Dr to Gulfside Pavilion, 20 Casino Beach Boardwalk, Pensacola Beach, FL 32561
paras: Visit Pensacola lists the Surfin' Santa Parade on Sunday, December 6, from 2 PM to 3:30 PM, starting at Avenida 10 and ending at the Gulfside Pavilion near Casino Beach.
The Pensacola Beach Chamber of Commerce lists the same parade at 2 PM and gives a phone number for questions, (850) 932-1500.
tip: The parade ends at the Gulfside Pavilion by Casino Beach, so plan beach time afterward.

name: Holiday on the Bay at Venetian Village
venue: The Village Shops on Venetian Bay
address: 4200 Gulf Shore Blvd N, Naples, FL 34103
host: The Village Shops on Venetian Bay
paras: The Village Shops on Venetian Bay hosts Holiday on the Bay, an afternoon and evening of holiday traditions on the waterfront. The host lists complimentary photos with Santa, festive character appearances, live holiday carolers and walkways lit with more than 100,000 lights.
At 6 PM guests gather around Naples' tallest Christmas tree as snow begins to fall. The host also mentions dinner along the water for families finishing holiday shopping.
tip: Be at the tree by 6 PM for the snow.
